name: Phpmyadmin
description: Phpmyadmin is a free software tool written in PHP, intended to handle the administration of MySQL over the Web. phpMyAdmin supports a wide range of operations on MySQL and MariaDB.
short_desc: Phpmyadmin is a free software tool written in PHP, intended to handle the administration of MySQL over the Web
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: PMA_ARBITRARY
form_fields.hint: Set to 1 to allow you to connect to any server. Setting to 0 will only allow you to connect to specified hosts (See Application Setup)

form_fields.label: PMA_ABSOLUTE_URI
form_fields.hint: Set the URL you will use to access the web frontend
